decisions.reason: As a training programme that builds on the firm's established service offer, it likely meets the firm's historical aspiration and has low uncertainty, so slack is not needed to justify keeping it.
This fourth rotary axis accessory is complementary to the firm's core milling equipment and close to existing accessories, making a performance shortfall unlikely.

Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the firm's established offer and its results are uncertain, so if it falls below aspiration the firm is likely to search for alternative uses or drop it.
A high-speed CNC milling machine line with several models is central to the firm's established high-speed equipment business and is very unlikely to be withdrawn.
An automatic tool change system builds on the firm's established machine tool and accessory capabilities, so it likely performs close to aspiration and is retained.
